title: Accumulated earnings and PHC taxes — two corporations
instructions: Compute the penalty taxes for two C corporations.

exhibits.title: Brookfield Inc. (operating company)
exhibits.content: Taxable income: **$1,000,000**; federal income tax: **$210,000**; dividends paid: **$100,000**; accumulated earnings credit (reasonable business needs): **$300,000**. Assume no other adjustments.

exhibits.title: Lyle Holdings (investment company)
exhibits.content: Adjusted ordinary gross income: **$500,000**, of which **$350,000** is dividends and interest. Five individuals own 80% of the stock all year. Undistributed personal holding company income after the dividends-paid deduction: **$150,000**.

rows.label: Lyle's PHC income as a percentage of AOGI
Does Lyle meet both PHC tests?
rows.explanation: 70% exceeds the 60% income test, and 5 individuals own over 50%.

rows.label: Can a corporation owe both the PHC tax and the accumulated earnings tax in the same year?
rows.explanation: A PHC isn't subject to the accumulated earnings tax.

rows.label: Could Lyle reduce the PHC tax with consent dividends?
rows.explanation: Consent dividends give a dividends-paid deduction without cash.
